Decision: OpenCloud selected for lab-6td.1. Full comparison and rationale recorded in design/opencloud-vs-nextcloud.md. Nextcloud was never deployed (no user data), so documented migration limitations are moot. Accepted gaps: no calendar/contacts/Talk equivalents, Zitadel integration not officially documented (fallback: embedded IdP), Collabora-only office.

Revision 2: decision reversed to KEEP Nextcloud. Existing instance (~300GB, ~5 sharees) invalidates Revision 1's greenfield premise. OpenCloud on Storage Box is impossible (decomposedfs needs POSIX symlinks/atomic metadata; SMB xattr ':' names break grants; no WebDAV/SFTP driver exists — verified in code, #1455/#3190/#2173/#894). Nextcloud datadir-on-CIFS is conditionally viable (AIO ships a Storage Box recipe) with appdata/tempdir forced local NVMe + Valkey locking; cutover gated on a 4-item test. Record: design/opencloud-vs-nextcloud.md
